feature_descriptions.Fey Magic: Gain the Illusion sphere as a bonus magic talent.
feature_descriptions.Shadowstuff: Shadow points and shadow-powered abilities use the live Fey Adept resource module.

resources.name: Shadow Points
resources.description: Shadow points equal half Fey Adept level plus Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and replenish with spell points.

resources.name: Shadowmark Dice
resources.description: Number of d6 dealt by Shadowmark.

resources.name: Shadowmark Will Penalty
resources.description: Penalty against this Fey Adept's sphere abilities for one minute; it does not stack with itself.

resources.name: Master Illusionist Duration
resources.description: Rounds an illusion remains after concentration ends.

resources.name: Truesight
resources.description: Daily uses of 120-foot truesight for one round per Fey Adept level.

resources.name: Create Reality
resources.description: Select the quasi-real illusion being created. It costs one shadow point plus one per spell point the mimicked effect would require.

resources.name: Permanent Illusion
resources.description: At 20th level record the one illusion currently designated permanent.

notes: The Illusion sphere grant is part of the advancement budget. Shadow points, Shadowmark scaling, Truesight, Create Reality, and the permanent illusion are live shared resources.
